note: Reconstructed AFTER the fact, by reading the n8n executions API. A recovered number and a captured number are different evidence, and this is the recovered kind. Nothing here was recorded when the calls were made, which is the defect this file documents.
recorded: after the fact, from GET /executions?includeData=true, on 2026-09-11

what_happened.summary: The acceptance gate was paying for its own mutation testing, on every run, and nothing said so.
chain: The gate applies the mutation `the-env-file-overriding-a-chosen-value`, which deletes the line making the environment beat the repo's .env file.
It then runs the test file that declares that mutation's named test.
That same file holds the tests which spawn scripts/run-scenarios.mjs as a real child process, with a localhost address in the environment.
With the guard mutated away, .env overwrote that localhost address with the live paid instance.
Every such test then POSTed to the paid webhook.
what_happened.established_how: Reproduced by hand with the new interlock in place, so it cost nothing: applying the mutation made the resolved address `dimitarshenkov.app.n8n.cloud`, and the run stopped before calling it.
what_happened.corroboration: The number of live executions per burst tracks the number of e2e tests that spawn the runner: pairs with a 5-second stagger while there were two such tests, then triples sub-second on the day a third was added. Bursts line up with gate and full-suite runs, not with any timer.

executions.range_read: 300 to 329, all on 2026-09-11, all mode webhook, none a retry

authorised_by_the_owner.why: each bought with the word, one run each

of_which_free.why: all three died at Ask kubernetes with a Bad request before any model call — a MEASURED zero, not an unknown

totals.source: the provider's own usage object on each Ask <agent> HTTP node, which is the authoritative figure
totals.why: the repository records a price for gpt-4o-mini only. These ran on gpt-5 and gpt-5-mini, whose prices are not recorded here, so the dollar cost is UNESTABLISHED rather than estimated. A guessed price would make the one number that is supposed to be measured into a number somebody invented.

a_second_defect_found_while_reading.what: The Report node's own usage_by_agent field is populated on only 18 of the 30 executions, empty on 9 and absent on 3.
a_second_defect_found_while_reading.cost_of_trusting_it: summing that field gives 359881 tokens against a true 553506 — an under-count of 193625, or 35%.
a_second_defect_found_while_reading.so: any counter that reads usage_by_agent as its source under-reports by a third. The Ask nodes' own usage objects are the source.

fixed_by: liveCallFromTestLedger in scripts/run-scenarios.mjs: a claims ledger under the temporary directory, which only a test sets, refuses any non-loopback address BEFORE the POST. The mutation stays, because .env beating a chosen environment value is a real defect worth catching; what was missing was a floor under it.
